title: 분필가루
suno_analysis_sp: K-Hip Hop track featuring a male rapper with a laid-back, rhythmic flow. The beat is built around a jazzy, sampled piano loop playing minor seventh chords and a syncopated boom-bap drum pattern. A melodic electric bass follows the kick drum with occasional slides. Subtle vinyl crackle and atmospheric city noise are layered in the background. The tempo is 92 BPM in the key of C minor. The production uses light compression on the vocals and a short room reverb on the snare.
